title: Learning Soft Robotic Dynamics with Active Exploration
abstract: arXiv:2510.27428v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Soft robots offer adaptability and safety in unstructured environments, yet their compliant, high-dimensional, and nonlinear dynamics make modeling for control difficult. Existing data-driven approaches often fail to generalize, constrained by narrowly focused task demonstrations or inefficient random exploration. We introduce an uncertainty-aware active exploration framework that autonomously learns task-agnostic and generalizable dynamics models of soft robotic systems. We evaluate this framework on three simulated platforms---a continuum arm, an articulated fish in fluid, and a musculoskeletal leg---and on a real-world pneumatically actuated continuum arm. Compared with random exploration and task-specific baseline, our method achieves higher modeling accuracy by actively collecting informative data. This improved model quality yields higher returns in zero-shot control on unseen tasks and robust performance under sensing no

translated_title: 基于主动探索的软体机器人动力学学习
translated_abstract: 软体机器人在非结构化环境中具有适应性和安全性，但其柔顺、高维且非线性的动力学特性使得面向控制的建模十分困难。现有的数据驱动方法往往难以泛化，受限于范围狭窄的任务演示或低效的随机探索。我们提出了一种不确定性感知的主动探索框架，能够自主学习任务无关且可泛化的软体机器人系统动力学模型。我们在三个仿真平台上对该框架进行了评估——连续体机械臂、流体中带关节的仿生鱼以及肌肉骨骼腿——并在真实世界的气动驱动连续体机械臂上进行了验证。与随机探索和特定任务基线相比，我们的方法通过主动收集信息丰富的数据实现了更高的建模精度。这种改进的模型质量在未见任务的零样本控制中带来了更高的回报，并在传感噪声下表现出鲁棒性能。
tldr: 提出了一种不确定性感知的主动探索框架，通过主动收集信息丰富的数据，自主学习任务无关且可泛化的软体机器人动力学模型，在仿真和真实平台上的建模精度与零样本控制性能均显著优于随机探索和特定任务基线。
en_tdlr: Proposes an uncertainty-aware active exploration framework that autonomously learns task-agnostic, generalizable dynamics models of soft robots by actively collecting informative data, achieving higher modeling accuracy and zero-shot control performance than random exploration and task-specific baselines on both simulated and real-world platforms.
